sources.title: Calendar Resource Management README at v0.12.2
sources.locator: Configuration table, room/resource/vehicle/restriction commands, unique email caveat, and cron note (README lines 193-228).
observed_operations: web.click release/commit link, then reopened exact pinned README URL
bounded_observations: Resource entities include buildings, floors (internal term story), rooms, general resources, vehicles, and group restrictions.

sources.title: Using the Calendar app, Nextcloud User Manual
sources.source_kind: official versioned manual served via latest URL

sources.locator: Room/resource booking and rejected overlaps (lines 220-230); calendar share read/write effects (lines 74-85); calendar .ics export (lines 57-66); trash retention default 30 days (lines 263-272).
observed_operations: web.find room/resource and overlapping-time passages; inspected resulting lines
bounded_observations: The manual says later overlapping resource bookings are rejected and resources require an installed/configured back end.

Calendar deletion/export and trash have stated behaviors; current docs identify a 30-day default trash interval, which administrators may change.
sources.limitations: Manual is for Nextcloud 36 and dynamically served at `latest`; the resource-management app catalog evidence in S04 lists compatibility through 35 only. Recheck a matching version pair.

observed_operations: web.open exact URL; inspected calendar:export and calendar:import options
bounded_observations: `calendar:export` defaults to iCal/RFC 5545; xCal and jCal are alternatives.
Import validation accepts 0=no validation, 1=validate and skip invalid, 2=validate and fail; error mode 0 continues by default and 1 fails on first error.
sources.limitations: This describes one exported calendar, not a whole case/task repository, and the docs do not establish attachments/notes coverage.

sources.title: PouchDB Conflicts guide

bounded_observations: Two offline copies can edit the same revision; the deterministic algorithm picks a shared winner while retaining a conflict branch that an application can expose and resolve.
sources.limitations: Describes document replication conflicts; unique separate reservation documents can still represent incompatible bookings without a same-document collision.
